test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mr. Akai starts from Point A and drives 18 km towards south. He then takes a right turn, drives 25 km, turns right and drives 9 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 4 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 14 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Mr. Akai starts at Point A

18 km South 
25 km West 
9 km North 
11 km East 
5 km South 
4 km East
14 km North [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a00e871e85276170d70e1c885338859d7285ad0d7e79a8d28693cfc6080886d.png] 

So, To return from P to A: Move 10 km East

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
